name: Corporate Professional
desc: Crisp executive architecture with formal dual-line dividers, high visual hierarchy, and authoritative corporate presence.

name: Executive Resume
desc: Two-column architecture featuring a dedicated credentials sidebar for skills, contact info, and education alongside an executive leadership history canvas.

name: Business Professional
desc: Polished business management format with prominent contact header band, boxed key competencies, and structured career milestones.

name: Minimal Professional
desc: Monochromatic high-contrast styling with generous whitespace, delicate hairline separators, and understated typographical elegance.

name: Elegant Professional
desc: Sophisticated serif typography with centered monogram initials badge, warm charcoal accents, and traditional prestige layout.

name: Modern Minimal
desc: Clean modern sans-serif layout with vertical accent border, clean pill tags, and compact modern spacing.

name: Creative Modern
desc: Top vibrant gradient header card with metric callout chips and modern border accents. Perfect for product leaders and creators.

name: Two-Column Modern
desc: Asymmetric 35/65 split grid with full-height tinted sidebar, skill level indicators, and high-impact right column.

name: Stylish Resume
desc: Contemporary career timeline aesthetic with connected milestone dots, floating name badge, and dot-accented skill chips.

name: Gradient Modern
desc: Vibrant gradient underlined titles, card-styled sections with soft glass borders, and contemporary typography.

name: ATS Classic
desc: Harvard & Ivy League standard linear format with zero graphics, high-contrast typography, and maximum parse-rate across Taleo, Workday, and Greenhouse.

name: ATS Professional
desc: Strict standard single-column with uppercase section headers, bulleted accomplishments with action verbs, and universal parser compatibility.

name: Simple One-Column
desc: Clean linear hierarchy with centered header, pipe-separated contact info, and crisp section dividers.

name: Clean Corporate
desc: Solid horizontal section lines separating bold role titles, bulleted points, and strict adherence to corporate ATS scanning rules.

name: Text-Based Professional
desc: Markdown and plain-text inspired ultra-clean layout with bracketed dates and bulleted lists. Maximum readability for bots and humans.

name: Software Developer
desc: Engineered for developers: GitHub/portfolio badges, monospace tech stack chips (`Tech: React, Node, AWS`), and metrics-focused bullets.

name: AI/ML Engineer
desc: Specialized architecture for AI/ML specialists: dedicated Model & Frameworks taxonomy, research milestones, and compute metrics.

name: Data Scientist
desc: Quantitative profile header with stats callout bar (latency, accuracy, throughput) and categorized analytical competencies.

name: Web Developer
desc: Interactive web aesthetic with live demo links, frontend/backend/devops categorizations, and modern web badge styling.

name: IT Professional
desc: Prominent Certifications & Security box (AWS, Cisco, CompTIA), network/cloud skills matrix, and incident mitigation layout.

name: College Student
desc: Education placed prominently at the top with GPA, honors, relevant coursework, followed by Capstone Projects and Technical Skills.

name: Fresher Resume
desc: Engineered for entry-level graduates: prominent Career Objective, Academic Projects, Technical & Soft Skills, and Extracurriculars.

name: Internship Resume
desc: Highlights availability, internship target, hackathons, club leadership, and coursework with faculty references.

name: Academic Resume
desc: Traditional academic curriculum vitae format: Education first, Research Interests, Publications, Theses, and Distinctions.

name: Compact High-Density
desc: Engineered for senior professionals with extensive careers who must present a clean, zero-overflow single-page resume.
